Q0391

“There is no greater pain than to recall happy times in misery.” — Dante Alighieri (Inferno V.121–123)

Verified English quotation. Primary source: Inferno V.121–123. Theme: memory.

Source context

Archive record: this English passage is associated with Inferno V.121–123, within the Scholasticism tradition. Use the cited work or edition when a scholarly attribution is needed.

A short reading

Read in the register of memory, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In Dante Alighieri's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
